title: Signatures can be replayed using different addresses
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  The `commitToMint` function in the contract allows signatures signed by the `signer` to be replayed using different addresses. Anyone can see the signatures on-chain and then replay them with different accounts that have the same nonce.
